note: Severe network degradation this run: of the ~20 distinct sources attempted, roughly 14 (well over 1/3) returned DNS/egress-proxy ENOTFOUND on direct WebFetch -- all 6 non-Anthropic model blogs, both main aggregators, the HN API, and every one of the 8 configured expert sources' own domains (youtube.com entirely, plus latent.space, oneusefulthing.org, simonwillison.net, grahamdumpleton.me, addyosmani.com, thezvi.substack.com, lesswrong.com, news.ycombinator.com, every.to, microsoft.ai, aitoolsreview.co.uk). Only anthropic.com, github.com and WebSearch itself stayed reachable. Two workarounds kept this run from being empty: (1) a git clone of simonw/simonwillisonblog-backup gave exact-dated access to Simon Willison's linkblog, which is how the Muru/Dumpleton piece was found and verified; (2) direct WebFetch of github.com/muruhq/muru supplied real README detail for that same note page. The news side cleared only 2 items and expert_content only 1 (vs. the configured minimum of 5) despite a genuinely widened pass (extra vendors, extra outlets, 7-day expert window) -- this reflects verified scarcity plus the blocking above, not a shortened search. No invented URLs, quotes, or dates were used to pad either count.
